tours.name: Required Fields on a New Payslip Batch

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Payslip Batch

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a payslip batch without its name or period.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a payslip batch without its name or period.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Batches are managed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Batches are managed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period.

description_i18n.en_US: A batch groups the payslips of one pay period.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a payslip batch.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a payslip batch.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The message names the missing fields, such as the batch name or the period. A batch needs a period so Odoo knows which payslips to generate.

description_i18n.en_US: The message names the missing fields, such as the batch name or the period. A batch needs a period so Odoo knows which payslips to generate.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real payslip batch.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real payslip batch.
